editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where the sun just refuses to rise, and you are stuck in a night that lasts forever. That is exactly the wild ride you get with this flick. You follow Mick Small and his buddy Rod as they dive into a strange mystery to find out what happened to Mick's dad. Since the band Goose stars in this, the whole thing feels like a giant party mixed with a weird dream. It is not your typical Hollywood story; it is more of a fun, trippy companion piece to their album that keeps you wondering what is actually going on.

You will notice that the pacing is quick and the comedy hits just right, though some of the acting feels a bit loose since the cast are musicians first. The best part is how the music blends with the action and the mystery. If you want the best experience, you should definitely look for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection so you can really feel the sound. Otherwise, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to check it out. It is a perfect pick if you love indie vibes and quirky sci-fi.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the endless night is tied to a strange loop involving the club. Mick finally discovers the truth about his father, realizing that the mystery was a puzzle designed to test him. Once the truth is revealed, the cycle breaks and the world finally returns to normal. Everything wraps up with a feeling of peace as Mick finds closure and the sun finally rises on the horizon.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves jam bands and weird sci-fi stories.
